summary: Submitted a repeat of fixed experiment 3b4f2310a3bf43a492eea0cfedd79dd0-experiment to test reproducibility of the replay-completion results that currently rest on single executions. Its harness contains the replay, bound, boundary and default-configuration cases, so one clean-copy repeat re-observes the boundary pair (2048 delivered tuples returning versus 2049 blocking at MaxAppendEntries 16) and the default-configuration pair (12001 committed entries above an absent snapshot with default SnapshotThreshold/interval, flag-on restart blocking, flag-off control returning), plus the earlier block-and-bound cases. The rationale states the reproduction question explicitly: whether the two pairs return the same operands and the same split between a blocked replay-enabled restart and a returning flag-off control, which the account's schedule-variation limitation cannot answer today. No new investigation, source or knowledge record accompanies it; the repeat consumes one execution and its receipt will be cited in the account if a further turn is granted, otherwise it stands as an uncited reproducibility receipt.
